reforms.description: Canada introduced measures to address supply-side constraints including technological factors, vocational training, labour mobility, industrial research, and marketing efforts in response to slower economic growth.
reforms.component_name: Industrial Research and Technological Development Initiative
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: Increased industrial research and technological development directly enhance productivity and innovation capacity, addressing identified supply-side constraints that have limited economic growth.
reforms.status_evidence: The text states 'Increased awareness of these problems has led the authorities to introduce measures designed to cope with them,' indicating announcement of measures but not yet full implementation.
reforms.importance_rationale: A significant policy response to structural growth constraints, addressing multiple supply-side dimensions including industrial research, but presented as a package of measures rather than a single major reform. The emphasis on industrial research as part of a broader growth strategy indicates meaningful but not transformative scope.
reforms.source_quote: There has, however, been considerable discussion in Canada of the need for more vocational training, better mobility of labour and capital, more industrial research and increased marketing efforts. Increased awareness of these problems has led the authorities to introduce measures designed to cope with them.
